rule: One frozen structured split of the SPX surface from hardcoded_v1: rank expiries by maturity and, within each expiry, rank strikes. A quote is CALIBRATION if (expiry_rank + strike_rank) is even, HELD OUT otherwise. Within calibration, quotes whose strike rank is a multiple of 5 form the DEVELOPMENT subset used for the residual hyper-parameters. Hashes recorded before any residual training.
